parameters.jsCode: const rows=$input.all().map(i=>i.json);const byId={};for(const row of rows){const f=row.fields??row;const id=String(row.id??f['Record ID']??'').trim();if(id)byId[id]=String(f.Name??id);}return [{json:{byId}}];

'OR(' + names.map(name => `ARRAYJOIN({Clients Table})='${String(name).replace(/'/g, "\\'")}'`).join(',') + ')' : 'FALSE()'; const day = "DATEADD(TODAY(),-1,\'days\')"; const recent = "OR(IS_SAME({First Inbound Reply At},"+day+",'day'),IS_SAME({Latest Reply Time},"+day+",'day'),IS_SAME({First Response At},"+day+",'day'),IS_SAME({Meeting Booked At},"+day+",'day'),IS_SAME({Dulcy Reply Agent Sent At},"+day+",'day'),AND(OR(FIND('In Conversation',ARRAYJOIN({Lead Status})),{Pipeline Stage}='In Conversation'),IS_SAME(DATETIME_PARSE(ARRAYJOIN({Status timestamp})),"+day+",'day')))"; return 'AND(' + active + ',' + recent + ')'; })() }}

parameters.jsCode: const rows=$('Consolidate Emails').first().json.emails||[];const workspaces=$('Get Workspaces').all().map(i=>i.json);const out=[];for(const row of rows){const f=row.fields||row;if(f.duplicate_for_tests||String(f['Leads Email']||'').endsWith('.invalid'))continue;const ids=Array.isArray(f['Clients Table'])?f['Clients Table']:[];const ws=workspaces.filter(w=>ids.includes(w.id)&&String(w.ID)===String(f['Workspace ID (Bison)']));if(ws.length!==1||!ws[0]['EmailBison API']||!/^\d+$/.test(String(f.reply_message_id||'')))continue;out.push({json:{record:{id:row.id,fields:f},workspaceId:ws[0].id,apiKey:ws[0]['EmailBison API'],replyId:String(f.reply_message_id)}});}if(out.length>1000)throw Error('Metrics batch exceeds 1000 conversations; review scope before requesting more');return out.length?out:[{json:{skip:true}}];

parameters.query: WITH rows AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb)), saved AS (INSERT INTO dulcy_reply_agent.thread_metrics (workspace_id,conversation_id,record_id,facts,observed_at) SELECT value->>'workspaceId',value->>'id',value->>'recordId',value,(value->>'observedAt')::timestamptz FROM rows ON CONFLICT (workspace_id,conversation_id) DO UPDATE SET record_id=EXCLUDED.record_id,facts=EXCLUDED.facts,observed_at=EXCLUDED.observed_at RETURNING conversation_id) SELECT count(*) AS saved FROM saved;
SELECT facts FROM dulcy_reply_agent.thread_metrics WHERE observed_at>now()-interval '90 days' ORDER BY workspace_id,conversation_id;
